prompt:
Square mobile game app icon artwork, full bleed edge to edge, 1:1. No text, no letters, no logo, no border, no frame, no rounded-corner tile, no transparency, no checkerboard. Premium cozy 3D toy style with soft vinyl-toy materials, rendered like a still from a high-end animated film: soft global illumination, gentle subsurface glow on the skin, clean rounded shapes, soft but clear shadows, vivid yet balanced colours (not washed out, not neon).
Main character "Okti", a cute baby octopus, sits on warm golden beach sand, centred horizontally, filling about 85 percent of the icon width. Okti has a big smooth egg-shaped head, slightly wider than tall, bright saturated sky-blue skin (#3F8ED8) with very faint darker blue freckles, a gentle slightly narrower waist under the head and a soft rounded skirt that rests on the sand. The face is on the lower half of the head: two big glossy dark navy bead eyes (#161C3E), set wide apart and low, each with one large white highlight at the upper left and a small second highlight at the lower right; a small happy closed smile in dark plum (#4A2230) centred below the eyes; two soft round pink blush cheeks (#F48AA5) below and outside the eyes. No eyebrows, no nose, no teeth, no clothes.
Eight tentacles spread unevenly and asymmetrically on the sand around the body, thick at the root and tapering to rounded tips; each tip curls upward in a spiral that faces the viewer. Rows of filled pale pink suckers (#F9CFD8 with darker pink centres #E690A8) run along the lower edge of each tentacle and inside the curls, shrinking toward the tips. The left tentacle makes one big spiral curl on the sand; the front tentacles fan out with different lengths and small curls. The right tentacle is raised beside the head and its tip wraps around a single large round cream-pink pearl (#E4D2CC, soft pearly sheen, one small warm highlight, shaded underside), proudly holding it at shoulder height in front of the sea; the tentacle tip crosses in front of the pearl's lower left.
In the sand at the front left lies one small fan-shaped scallop shell with radial ribs, a wavy edge and two small hinge ears: coral orange (#FF9A72) ribs with pale peach (#FFE2CF) between them.
A soft contact shadow under the body and the tentacles makes Okti feel grounded and settled.
Setting: a tropical island beach at sunrise. The camera is slightly above Okti, about 7 degrees looking down, with a 50 mm lens feel. The horizon sits about one third from the top. The sky is a warm sunrise gradient: golden yellow (#FFD27C) near the horizon, warm orange (#FB9B58) higher up and soft coral orange (#F38A63) at the top. A low bright sun glow sits just above the horizon on the right side and puts a warm rim light on Okti's right edges. The calm turquoise sea (#59D9CF near the shore to #137BB4 far away) reflects the warm sky, with a glittering sun reflection column under the sun and a thin white foam line where the waves meet the darker wet sand. Golden sand (#F8DCAA, slightly darker wet sand near the water) with a fine grain. On the left stands a single palm tree: its ringed tan trunk rises from the sand near the left edge and leans out of frame to the left, and its green fronds hang in from the top left corner, staying clear of Okti's head. On the far right horizon there is a small green islet with a tiny red and white lighthouse. Keep the bottom right corner of the image calm, with plain sand only, because a badge will be placed there later.
